summary.motive: Deploy symmetrical 4-deep match (Palms / 2-Read) from the identical 2-high pre-snap shell to jump quick out routes and rob crossing patterns.
summary.keyDefender: STAR (Nickel) reading #2 out-break and BS (Boundary Safety) driving top-down on #1
summary.whyItWorks: Palms rules allow the underneath nickel/corner to aggressively jump shallow out-breaking routes because the safety is keyed to drive on any inside break by #1.
summary.failureMode: Double moves or Wheel-Post combinations if the safety hesitates on the trigger.

beats.title: Disguised Two-High Safety Stem
beats.text: Fangio shows the identical two-high safety look as Cover 6. Pre-snap, the QB anticipates soft boundary cushions or Cover 2 holes.

beats.title: Palms 2-Read: Star DB Jumps the Out
beats.text: The moment #2 H breaks on the shallow out route, STAR triggers downhill with full aggression to undercut the flat throw under Palms rules.

beats.title: Boundary Safety Drives Top-Down on Post
beats.text: With STAR taking the out, Boundary Safety BS reads the route distribution and drives downhill from 12 yards to completely erase X on the post.

beats.title: Contested Catch Window on Intermediate Dig
beats.text: The QB resets and fires to Y on the dig, but MIKE and FS close the vice clamp from underneath and over the top to force the incompletion.

relations.tell: Both safeties trigger top-down at 10-12 yards matching #2 receivers vertical while Star DB plays palms flat.
